text:
In vain your friendship anxiously tries
to guess the ill that torments me;
in vain, my friend, moved, my voice attempts
to reveal it to your tenderness.


The longing, the madness can be explained
with which love feeds its fires…
Pain, the most violent rage,
can breathe its bitterness through the lips.


But to speak of my deep unease,
my voice and thought can find no means,
and when I search its source I lose myself:


yet it is a terrible, incurable ill,
that makes life hateful, the world hateful,
that dries the heart… In short, it is tedium!

translation.title: In Vain Your Friendship Anxiously Tries...
